title: Renormalisation of chiral gauge theories with non-anticommuting gamma5 at the multi-loop level (PhD thesis, TU Dresden 2025); and proceedings 'Dimensional regularisation with non-anticommuting gamma5: status and application to the Standard Model' (PoS(LL2026)076)
claim: Thesis: algorithmic QAP-based restoration method; complete four-loop renormalization of an abelian chiral gauge theory; study of dimensional ambiguities and evanescent terms with prescriptions for D-dim fermions and gauge interactions; full one-loop SM renormalization in BMHV. Proceedings: status review up to four loops and the one-loop SM.
red_flags: Summary of S3.11, S3.12, S3.14, S3.15; abstract-level.
notes: Also proceedings arXiv:2407.07247 (Kuehler, Stoeckinger, Weisswange, 'Advances at the gamma5-frontier').
